payload.question: Should we raise cold brew prices again?

advisors.owns: Is what we serve worth the price on the board?
Will the neighbourhood notice, and what do they hear?
How will regulars feel, and will they come back?
Can we deliver it every day at a healthy margin?
What does it do to cash this month and next quarter?
